topic: Adjusting traffic model data for metro and rail
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on updating a traffic prediction model for Metro and Rail locations. [p1] confirmed that the factor used for both Metro and Rail is consistent with City data (factor of 19). A specific location, AFA 169 Frederiksborggade 13 KØB0001DU, showed significantly lower manual countings compared to model predictions (model predicted ~2200 vs. manual count of 800).

It was determined that the discrepancy at this specific location is likely due to inaccurate or incomplete manual counting, possibly because the counters did not capture the full traffic flow. The general consensus was that the model performs well for all other rail and metro locations.

As a result, [p1] decided to mark the data from AFA 169 Frederiksborggade 13 as 'not trusted'.
decisions: The factor used for Metro and Rail traffic modeling is set at 19.
Data from AFA 169 Frederiksborggade 13 KØB0001DU will be marked as not trusted due to discrepancies between manual counts and model predictions.
action_items: Mark the data for AFA 169 Frederiksborggade 13 for recount in the future.
